prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one square transparent 2 by 2 atlas of FOUR distinct New Year website illustrations. Top-left: ornate antique midnight clock with hands at twelve, gold stars and a midnight-blue satin bow. Top-right: two elegant clinking champagne flutes with curling blue and gold ribbons. Bottom-left: a luxurious navy party hat beside a gold party horn with silver confetti. Bottom-right: a small cluster of three gold and silver star-shaped balloons with navy ribbons. Midnight navy, champagne gold, silver and warm ivory. No printed year, no words. Style: premium richly detailed hand-painted storybook collectibles, precise ink contours, layered realistic textures, subtle dimensional shading, luminous warm edges on dark backgrounds, elegant and playful rather than childish. Match an existing collection of detailed black cats on glowing pumpkins, ornate potion bottles, evergreen trees, and golden bells. Composition is STRICT: each of the four separate illustrations must fit COMPLETELY within its own quadrant, occupying only 70 percent of that cell. Leave an uninterrupted fully transparent cross-shaped gutter at least 10 percent of total canvas width between the left/right and top/bottom cells, plus clear outer padding. No part of any subject or ribbon touches a quadrant boundary or canvas edge. Four individual subjects, never a connected scene. No extra scattered objects in gutters. Truly transparent background including every gap, no backdrop, no checkerboard, no ground shadow, no frame, no text, no labels. Crisp detailed silhouettes readable at small sizes.
